title: Irrecoverable Carbon - Conservation International
description: Cloud-optimized GeoTIFFs (COGs) of Conservation International's Irrecoverable Carbon layers, representing carbon stocks held in ecosystems that cannot be recovered within a human lifetime if lost. The dataset provides global raster coverage and is derived from the analysis published in Nature Sustainability (doi:10.1038/s41893-021-00803-6), intended to support conservation prioritization to prevent irreversible carbon loss.

## README.md
# Irrecoverable Carbon

Cloud optimized geotiffs (COGs) of the Conservation International Irrecoverable Carbon layers.

- Description in original publication: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41893-021-00803-6
- Raw data accessed from https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4091028

[Example leaflet map](https://data.source.coop/cboettig/carbon/map.html)
